leaf.title: Operating growth feasible under joint capacity and funding constraints
leaf.intent: Determine the expansion of revenue that is simultaneously feasible under physical operating capacity and the cash required to support working capital.
company_selection_criteria: Real operating capacity and working-capital relationships are identifiable, with a verifiable liquidity baseline
data_requirements: Time-phased capacity, explicit demand and pricing conditions, turnover response, cash allocation policy and mandatory non-expansion cash uses
answer_validity_conditions: Use one candidate scenario for all inequalities; do not use earnings from an expansion to fund its earlier cash needs.
Do not claim a demand forecast or legally committed financing from a capacity calculation; identify infeasibility and binding constraints.
leaf.distinct_from: Adds a joint operating-expansion boundary: capacity headroom alone and working-capital headroom alone need not be simultaneously attainable.

source_roles.period_binding: The specified observation period and its explicitly identified comparative or opening dates

Applicable funding restrictions, repayment dates or commitment conditions materially needed for the cash budget

variant.synthesis: Evaluate physical capacity and working-capital-funded expansion for the same candidate revenue and find the joint feasible boundary.
conditions: For SD use a fully documented cash-only budget or a report summarizing every material draw condition; undisclosed contractual eligibility cannot be assumed. Do not fund earlier working-capital needs with later expansion receipts.

composition.scope_compatibility: S1 covers one company and one expansion horizon; cash constraints must hold at dated checkpoints within that horizon.
feasibility_limits: Public data may not support intra-period funding or physical-capacity limits; absent facts require an explicit conditional model or rejection.
